recall.minute: Serving levers: model compression, decoding algorithms, systems. Quantization: ŵ = s·round(w/s), s = max|w|/(2^(b−1)−1); 1B params 4 GB fp32 → 2 GB 16-bit → 1 GB int8 → 0.5 GB int4; fewer bytes speeds bandwidth-bound decode. Outliers stretch shared scales (int4 per-tensor error 0.99 with one outlier vs 0.15 per-row); use per-group scales, calibration (GPTQ, AWQ). Pruning: unstructured (needs sparse kernels) vs structured (real dense speed-up); pipeline prune → recover → quantize → evaluate. Speculative decoding: draft k tokens, verify in one pass, accept/reject keeps the target distribution; E = (1 − α^(k+1))/(1 − α) = 3.36 at α = 0.8, k = 4. Continuous batching refills slots each step (55% → 90% utilisation, 1.63×); chunked prefill avoids stalls. Paged attention: 16-token KV blocks, block table, waste ~4%, prefix sharing. Metrics: TTFT, TPOT, throughput, cost: $2/h at 100 tok/s = 360k tok/h ≈ $5.56 per million.
